title: 1.5 Unit Synopsis and Review Questions
description: Unit 1 summary points and textbook review questions

questions.question: According to the unit summary, biology is a ____ studying living organisms from the simplest to the most complex ones.
Biology studies living organisms from ____.
options: the simplest to the most complex ones
the largest to the smallest economies
the oldest to the newest inventions
the hottest to the coldest planets
questions.correctAnswer: the simplest to the most complex ones

questions.question: Biology is dependent on technology in terms of ____.
Biology and technology are tightly blended and form biotechnology, which is useful in designing various devices and engineering systems to ____.
Biology and technology are tightly blended and form biotechnology, which is useful in designing various ____ and engineering systems.
The benefits of biology to technology are ____.
options: biological information on biological systems helpful to derive technological systems, working mechanisms and related products
industrial effluents that pollute clean air and drinking water
the depletion of natural resources caused by technology
biological weapons that destroy the natural world
questions.correctAnswer: biological information on biological systems helpful to derive technological systems, working mechanisms and related products

questions.question: The benefits of biology to technology are biological information on ____ helpful to derive technological systems, working mechanisms and related products.
Biological information on biological systems is helpful to derive technological systems, working mechanisms and ____.
Uses of technology in biology deal with ____ in the biological study process.
Uses of technology in biology deal with technical applications in the biological study process to ____.
According to the unit review, humans started house building by learning from ____.
According to the unit review, the blending of biology and technology ____.
According to the unit review, the East Gate Center building in Harare is designed by imitating ____.
Animals are described as sentient creatures. This means they ____.
options: have the capacity to feel pain
can produce their own food by photosynthesis
questions.correctAnswer: have the capacity to feel pain

questions.question: Part I of the unit review consists of ____.
Part II of the unit review consists of ____.
Part III of the unit review directs students to ____.
options: write a short answer to each question
mark each statement true or false
questions.correctAnswer: write a short answer to each question

questions.question: Which of the following is an essay question listed in Part III of the unit review?
options: What are the ethical issues of biology?
What is the capital city of Ethiopia?
questions.correctAnswer: What are the ethical issues of biology?

questions.question: The unit review essay question 2 asks students to describe the importance of biological systems to ____.
The device used to collect geographical data or information is ____.
The influences of biological and technological products on society and nature are ____.
options: The advantages of biology and technology
The development of biology and technology
